objective: Measure accepted engineering completion and avoidable work for the actual production request projection, including an already validated Git push.

model.selection: same inherited parent model and reasoning settings for every fresh fork_turns=none responder
model.transport: collaboration fresh responder; permitted I/O only protocol+request read and response write; nested provider tool traces unavailable

concurrency: paired cohorts of up to six live responders; arm start order alternates by task and repetition
primary: Independent acceptance within six decisions; retain every failure, timeout and malformed response.
practical_speedup_rule: Exploratory positive only if no acceptance degradation, at least 20% fewer paired seeded-case model decisions and at least 20% lower median paired observed component wall time; no universal or statistical-significance claim.
failure_denominators: All 24 trials retained. Failed trials contribute their full observed time; report completion counts and time together, never survivor-only speedup.
guardrails: fresh independent recheck of remote Git artifact
no hardcoded answer patches or branch-on-warning simulated policy
conditional_scope: Seeded observation/failure histories are created with actual fixture tools identically in both arms and measure continuation recovery, not natural stall incidence.
limitations: Exact backend revision, provider tokens and billing are UNKNOWN.
Nested responder tool-trace protocol compliance cannot be independently audited.
Four task clusters; three repetitions do not create twelve independent task types.
Controller dispatch and file-based response capture are included in observed latency.
